name: weighted_provider_selection_v1
description: Replaced always-Groq-first with weighted random selection (30:15). Share numbers are the expected ratio, not measured.

name: half_open_before_fix
description: Original breaker: half_open fell through to return True, so every request after cooldown became a probe

name: half_open_after_fix
description: Fixed breaker: half_open returns False, so only the first request after cooldown is the probe

name: gemini_thought_signature_fix
description: Unified OpenAI-shaped schema was silently dropping Gemini's thought_signature on multi-turn tool calls, causing 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT on turn 2. Fixed by capturing it in normalize_tool_calls (from response.candidates[0].content.parts) and replaying it in convert_messages.

name: stuck_probe_fix
description: InvalidRequestError during a half_open probe never called record_success or record_failure, leaving the breaker permanently stuck in half_open. Added record_inconclusive to reset it back to open with a fresh cooldown instead, so a later request gets a genuine test.

name: rpm_tpm_leak_fix
description: select_provider used 'rpm.try_consume() and tpm.try_consume()' which spent an RPM slot even when the TPM check failed right after, silently leaking provider capacity. Split TokenBucket into can_consume (check) and consume (commit), checking both buckets before spending either. Verified with Groq forced to go first and a deliberately-too-small TPM budget.
